classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve and analyze representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins annotated with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0034589) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0034588) activities and InterPro family IPR023382, then rank top candidates by sequence-derived biochemical metrics
assumptions: GO:0034589 is the molecular function term for ADP-dependent (S)-NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity; GO:0034588 is the adjacent ontology term for NADPHX epimerase activity — both are seeded from UniProt GO annotation corpus
IPR023382 covers the NAD(P)HX repair protein superfamily in InterPro and partially overlaps with GO-annotated sequence sets
A pre-built MMseqs2 database named 'uniref50' is accessible in the VPA execution environment for homolog expansion from dehydratase seed sequences
Sequence deduplication is enabled in all retrieval nodes to avoid redundant candidates entering the analysis and ranking steps

Ranking uses only sequence-derived biochemical metrics (amino acid composition, charge at pH 7.4, motifs, regional annotations) since no structural data is available for this sequence-understanding task
Taxonomic scope is unrestricted to capture full evolutionary diversity of the NAD(P)HX repair system across bacteria and eukaryotes
If GO:0034588 returns zero sequences (term may differ in current GO release), the epimerase arm falls back to InterPro coverage from fetch_interpro_nadhx

success_criteria.dehydratase_sequences_fetched: fetch_dehydratase returns at least 1 UniProt FASTA sequence annotated with GO:0034589
success_criteria.epimerase_sequences_fetched: fetch_epimerase returns at least 1 UniProt FASTA sequence annotated with GO:0034588
success_criteria.interpro_family_sequences_fetched: fetch_interpro_nadhx returns at least 1 UniProt FASTA sequence for IPR023382
success_criteria.homolog_expansion_complete: expand_dehydratase_homologs returns at least 1 MMseqs2 similarity hit at min_seq_id 0.3 and coverage 0.8
success_criteria.biochemical_profiles_computed: All three sequence_analysis nodes complete with composition, charge, motif, and per-residue annotation records
success_criteria.top_ranked_candidates: rank_nadhx_candidates produces a ranked list of top-10 representative NAD(P)HX repair protein candidates with composite scores
